title.narrative: Accelerating and Scaling the Just and Efficient Energy Transition in Mexico

description.narrative: The project provides technical assistance to Mexico’s Ministry of Energy (SENER) to develop and adopt the Energy Transition and Sustainable Use of Energy Plan (PLATEASE), a national planning document that will define objectives, goals, strategies, and sectoral measures for energy efficiency. GGGI will also assess and strengthen the three Energy Trust Funds owned and managed by SENER, providing recommendations and enhancements to ensure their effective and strategic operation. These improvements will accelerate resource mobilization, unlocking over USD 250 million to finance a Just Energy Transition. By fostering inclusive participation, integrating GEDSI, and aligning with President Sheinbaum’s Energy Reform and the National Development Plan 2025–2030, the project advances Mexico’s NDC 3.0 and SDG commitments through systemic and transformational climate action.

To reduce greenhouse gas emissions in Mexico by designing, adopting, and financing the National Energy Efficiency Component of the Energy Transition and Sustainable Use of Energy Plan (PLATEASE), strengthening energy trust funds to mobilize public and private investment, and providing the institutional, technical, and financial frameworks needed to improve energy efficiency, increase renewable energy adoption, and support a just and sustainable energy transition, thereby contributing to Mexico’s climate goals, Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0), and the National Development Plan 2025–2030.
